header.title: AFT BLOCK C: DANFOSS PVG 32 - 5 FUNCTIONS / HYDRAULIC SYSTEM

notes: Five repeated PVG 32 function sections are visible. Work-port labels A and B run along the upper section gallery but are per-section ports rather than shared supply/return rails. A line/gauge point marked M and a line marked LS are visible at the left-side inlet assembly. Additional auxiliary valves EV-10.6 and EV-10.7 appear below the two winch sections and are not counted as separate repeated PVG slices. Visible annotations include transom-door pressure checks (45 bar opening, 170 bar closing), winch LS_A adjustment notes to 260 bar, and an ON/OFF relief-valve adjustment from 150 to 225 bar. Small cartridge/manifold part numbers and some component-level fine print are not reliably legible at this resolution; examples of visible but uncertain small numbers should be reread from high-resolution crops.

flow_scenarios: Neutral/rest: the PVEO spool is in the explicitly stated open neutral position; the section is unloaded to return and the LS signal is vented/unloaded. The separate overcenter/load-holding assembly prevents uncontrolled actuator movement.

Opening command: OPEN=B, so pressure is routed P through the directional section to B; displaced oil from A returns through the opposite metering path to tank/return. The overcenter/load-holding assembly controls the overrunning return side. The sheet note calls for 45 bar in opening.

Closing command: CLOSE=A, so pressure is routed P through the directional section to A; displaced oil from B returns through the opposite metering path to tank/return. The overcenter/load-holding assembly controls the overrunning return side. The sheet note calls for 170 bar in closing.

Pressure limiting: each work-port pressure is sensed into the LS network; the two adjustable LS limiter cartridges vent/limit the selected LS signal when their respective thresholds are exceeded. The visible cartridge markings are 125 and 195, but their exact A/B assignment is not unambiguous in this crop.

Static/load-holding condition: with no pilot pressure commanding motion, the overcenter/load-holding valves block or meter reverse flow from the door actuator, while make-up/check paths permit required opposite-side flow.

flow_scenarios: OPEN command (B): the PVG spool connects pressure to work port B; the opposite A line is connected back through the section toward return. Pilot pressure from B releases/controls the load-holding element in the returning A line before oil can leave the actuator.

CLOSE command (A): the PVG spool connects pressure to work port A; the opposite B line is connected back through the section toward return. Pilot pressure from A releases/controls the load-holding element in the returning B line before oil can leave the actuator.

Neutral/rest: identified by the sheet as open neutral position. The work-port/load-holding block prevents uncontrolled door movement; the exact open-neutral internal gallery connection cannot be stated more specifically from this crop without guessing.

Overpressure/load-control condition: the two work-line load-holding elements in block 11166838 control or limit discharge from the loaded actuator side; the handwritten commissioning note calls for 175 bar in both opening and closing directions.

Pressure and tank/return galleries continue horizontally into adjacent manifold sections/off the crop.

flow_scenarios: Neutral/de-energized: closed-neutral spool blocks A and B from the section supply/return metering paths, holding the traveller stationary; LS demand is not generated by a commanded work-port path.

Command TO PORT (A): the directional spool connects pressure flow to A and connects B to tank/return; the A-side LS branch senses the loaded pressure and the shuttle passes the higher work-port signal to LS.

Command TO STBD (B): the directional spool connects pressure flow to B and connects A to tank/return; the B-side LS branch senses the loaded pressure and the shuttle passes the higher work-port signal to LS.

Excess load-sense pressure: the relevant A- or B-side LS pressure limiter opens/limits its LS branch at its adjusted threshold; symbols show 240 bar, while the red modification note specifies adjustment to 260 bar.
Section pressure relief: the ON/OFF-section pressure-control cartridge opens at its set threshold to protect/bypass the section; the revision note specifies increasing it from 150 bar to 225 bar.

flow_scenarios: Neutral: PVEO de-energized in the stated open-neutral position; the section is open in neutral. A/B service ports are not shown being actively driven; LS is vented/unloaded through the neutral section.

Command corresponding to A (1st and 3rd): pressure is metered through the main spool to work port A, while work port B is connected through the spool to the return gallery; the LS network senses the loaded work-port pressure.

Command corresponding to B (2nd): pressure is metered through the main spool to work port B, while work port A is connected through the spool to the return gallery; the LS network senses the loaded work-port pressure.
A-port overpressure: the A-side work-port relief opens to the common low-pressure/return passage at 260 bar.
B-port overpressure: the B-side work-port relief opens to the common low-pressure/return passage at 260 bar.

Manual ON/OFF relief/unloading valve operated: the external valve provides a connection between its A and B ports on the blue auxiliary line; the exact normal/open state and resulting destination are ambiguous in this crop.
LS overpressure: the LS pressure-limiter cartridge opens/limits the section's LS signal when its adjusted threshold is reached; the final adjusted value is cropped/illegible.

flow_scenarios: Neutral: stated open neutral position; the module provides an open neutral path. Exact gallery-to-tank routing cannot be traced unambiguously through the overlapped color lines.

Command to A (1st and 3rd winch direction): pressure is directed through the main spool to work port A and the opposite B line returns through the spool; the work-port/LS protection network senses the active load pressure.

Command to B (2nd winch direction): pressure is directed through the main spool to work port B and the opposite A line returns through the spool; the work-port/LS protection network senses the active load pressure.

Overpressure/load-sensing event: the active work-port signal is selected by the lower shuttle/check network and acted on by the corresponding pressure-control cartridge marked 60; the exact discharge/pilot destination is not unambiguously traceable in the crop.

Work-port transient or make-up event: the upper four-element bridge provides bidirectional work-port protection/check action between the A/B service lines; exact cracking directions and relief destinations are ambiguous from the drawing crop.
settings: Two lower-right pressure-control cartridges are each marked “60”; pressure unit is not shown in this crop.

B — work port; sheet legend assigns B to 2nd winch operation. It exits the top of this module and continues off-crop/off-sheet to the winch circuit.
LS_A and LS_B — load-sense connections at the lower manifold interface.
Pressure and tank/common manifold galleries connect at the lower/side interface, but their letter labels are outside or unclear in this crop.
